🍕 Free Buffet + VA Home Loan Tips? Count Us In. #vahomeloans 
Join us this Thursday, July 31st, from 6:30–8:30 PM at Mr. Gatti’s Pizza in Killeen for a FREE VA Home Loan Info Night hosted by the i35 Group! 🇺🇸

🎖️ Learn how to use your VA loan benefits to buy a home—from eligibility and credit tips to smart buying strategies.
🎤 Featuring special guest Danny Reyna, U.S. Air Force Veteran & Loan Expert (NMLS #363294)

This event is perfect for:
✅ Active-duty service members
✅ Veterans
✅ Military families in Central Texas looking to buy a home

📍 Mr. Gatti’s Pizza | Killeen
🗓 July 31st | ⏰ 6:30–8:30 PM
💬 Free to attend | Family-friendly | RSVP encouraged

📲 Call or text Bill Vernon at 254.495.5661 to reserve your seat!

https://www.facebook.com/share/1AgkvuwnD4/

i35 Group is a group of hard-working real estate agents always striving to get the best deal for our buyers and the most money for our sellers. We are neighborhood experts in Central Texas. Choose us for your real estate needs.
